name: Silver
notes: Benchmark Low-E metal. Price is the dominant cost driver of the whole coating; highly volatile, update before any techno-economic claim.

name: Copper
notes: Low-cost metal route. Oxidises readily; needs barrier layers.

name: Aluminium
notes: Abundant. AZO donor; poor visible optics as a Low-E mirror.

name: Zinc
notes: ZnO host cation. Cheap and abundant.

name: Tin
notes: SnO2 host. Harder and more chemically durable than ZnO.

name: Indium
notes: ITO benchmark only. Supply risk is the reason the brief rules it out.

name: Gallium
notes: GZO donor. Higher solubility than Al but materially more expensive.

name: Titanium
notes: Candidate dilute stabiliser and standard sacrificial barrier metal.

name: Nickel
notes: NiCr barrier alloys are the industrial default.

name: Chromium
notes: Hexavalent Cr concerns are a processing/waste issue, not a film issue.

name: Fluorine
notes: FTO donor. Introduced as a gas or from a fluorinated precursor.

name: Silicon
notes: Si3N4 and SiO2 are the standard protective and barrier dielectrics.
